preToolUse.command: payload="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/orlix-hook.XXXXXX")" || { cat >/dev/null; exit 0; }; trap 'rm -f "$payload"' EXIT HUP INT TERM; cat >"$payload"; root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0; hook="$root/.codex/hooks/pre_tool_use_guard.py"; [ -f "$hook" ] || exit 0; /usr/bin/python3 "$hook" <"$payload"
